\frac{dq}{dt} \le 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8071-86d1-e0078ce4b835" class="">Entropy increase is a <em>consequence</em> of constraint decay.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a6-aabf-c0a52bf5d33a" class="">This reframes the arrow as constraint relaxation.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8019-acac-d682e5e2f3f2"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8015-aa0e-d3a589a88473" class="">2) Hidden Conservation: Information Flow Budget</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806f-ba10-e81c2534c576" class="">Total entropy increases globally, but information does not disappear locally without cost.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ca-875f-f47b8800b011" class="">Define:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8054-9d73-e9944755a979" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I_{local}(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8038-8195-f2ff3e92b954" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\dot I_{local} = G(t) - D(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8015-8e1f-c7ae118a5677" class="">Where:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8011-a4b6-e46b544c03b1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: gradient-driven record creation</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e6-a53e-d96d965cffb1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: degradation via noise, mixing</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ac-8aae-d25cd2f17aff" class="">Sustainable recursion requires:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c0-bce8-f7e2c9df776e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
G(t) \ge D(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b2-8009-e5100444b533" class="">Once , records decay and recursion collapses.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8007-ae1a-ff70eeadee13" class="">Thus recursion depends on sustained non-equilibrium.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807b-93f0-c2d905839fb9"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b7-999f-cbf05bacb273" class="">3) Hidden Structural Requirement: Asymmetric Environment Capacity</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80af-9ed5-cf2d05a05770" class="">Define unused environmental degrees of freedom:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f6-a46f-e8c8b1cfeff0" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
U(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807b-a6e1-e5bdfdbeaeff" class="">Each new record consumes environment capacity:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8039-b476-dd6f911ea0e3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
U_{t+1} = U_t - \gamma R_{t+1}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d2-8ffb-ffb05af94da6" class="">Arrow persists only while:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8002-b48a-dfa97fffb384" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
U(t) &gt; 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8067-8b93-e118b2bc56cf" class="">This ties directly to horizon entropy bounds.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8010-b5ea-c3870a1bb6d8" class="">The Past Hypothesis guarantees:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b0-a03a-c2779a838453" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
U(t_0) \text{ maximal}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a1-b2e9-f60163b93aac"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8005-bb46-fa039d76abcd" class="">4) Stability Condition Across Time Scales</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8034-915d-f87ae61f73c4" class="">Structure formation requires scale hierarchy.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800f-b8c8-cfbe6f954d79" class="">Let time scales be:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8047-99e4-f55996010035" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\tau_{micro} \ll \tau_{chem} \ll \tau_{bio} \ll \tau_{cog}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ec-9b65-f612f21cd75c" class="">Stability requires:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8049-8310-e74a1e890e61" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\tau_{level} \ll \tau_{gradient}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e3-985d-f327f65da97d" class="">If gradient lifetime is shorter than level construction time, recursion cannot form.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802a-9ef5-f2c4c4e40de9" class="">Thus cosmology must provide time-scale separation.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d6-b109-e0ef15042787"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803e-a4c9-f8b5862db91a" class="">5) Overlooked: Predictability Bandwidth</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8046-a1e7-cd0c435f4cff" class="">Let predictability metric:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802c-8803-d93cb8fd91e9" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathcal{I}(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802a-aac4-c60a45968239" class="">If chaotic tidal fluctuations (high Weyl) dominate, predictability collapses.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802d-83a0-e1b5af5162bf" class="">Arrow and recursion require:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c4-86fa-c39dd7029586" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathcal{I}(t) \ge \mathcal{I}_{min}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e4-a8b5-cb0235544700" class="">Low initial Weyl increases predictability bandwidth.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8061-a9ac-e8582a222312" class="">This is rarely made explicit.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8084-938c-dd05fea0c9f3"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8036-ba11-fadca6f17f5c" class="">6) Control-Theoretic Ceiling (Deep Limit)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8029-a1ff-dd8b5900cb00" class="">Meta-recursive systems introduce delay.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80eb-98b7-d33af0868547" class="">Let depth-dependent delay:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809a-8001-ca31a79c8d69" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\tau_d \propto D</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8098-bbec-cd2c7f9a1f29" class="">Linearized stability condition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8060-96fb-c57518c37cae" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
|\alpha e^{-\lambda \tau_d}| &lt; 1</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8048-bfe6-d6e9b710224b" class="">Even with unlimited energy, increasing delay destabilizes the system.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8054-addc-f15c0ffcb600" class="">Thus recursion depth ceiling exists independent of energy.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b4-b12f-c8227566666e"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8095-9ec4-ca96dd4aaa7a" class="">7) Full State Vector (Closed System Form)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8073-9fc1-dbe6555d6895" class="">Define complete state:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808c-b2fa-f35f338a5f9d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
X_t =
\begin{bmatrix}
q(t) \\
G(t) \\
U(t) \\
R(t) \\
D(t) \\
P(t) \\
I_{max}(t) \\
\Xi(t)
\end{bmatrix}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ac-b4a8-ceb24a5947e1" class="">Update:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ce-ab41-e0355a05e162" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
X_{t+1} = F(X_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80cb-968d-dd8c4bcb9173" class="">Gates:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807d-b1e9-d7835110a1ba" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li>Gradient gate:</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c4-acac-fdf7ad7d0cc6" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li>Redundancy gate:</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808b-9034-f0938e9faca0" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li>Repair gate:</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8018-bc85-d882c1d4bac8" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li>Memory gate:</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8099-95fd-caedb288a570" class="numbered-list" start="5"><li>Control gate: stability under delay</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805d-8cb0-c34fe2e870f6" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\tau_G = \frac{G}{|\dot{G}|}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8067-a321-ff94a1b97367" class="">For stars, chemistry, and cognition to emerge:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800c-8f0d-d64d38b07f3f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\tau_G \gg \tau_{structure}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e3-ae8d-d34ad355ca58" class="">If gradients decay too quickly:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d3-a6aa-fcc2ee2020c5" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">no stable stars</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8063-b9b8-d851058d2e45" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">no chemical cycles</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800b-a879-f375fdc4be02" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">no recursion-capable systems</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8061-a3b3-f6ca4ad9952e" class="">Thus the real cosmological fine-tuning condition is:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8029-a67e-e081424ec67f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\tau_G \text{ large enough for recursive complexity}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8079-a829-eed845c77865" class="">This constraint is often omitted.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8007-a41e-ceebb86bd142"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805e-83e7-f291c4385258" class="">3) Information Is Not Free: Stability Requires Redundancy Scaling</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8052-9970-f180b3250c03" class="">Earlier we defined redundancy .</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c6-80ef-e5ce7f330da3" class="">Now add scaling:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80bc-974c-c0a558c8fdda" class="">To stabilize information against noise rate , redundancy must scale as:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8022-acf8-e080d6bc3cc5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
R \ge \frac{1}{(1 - p/p_{th})}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8074-a2f4-c8231376939c" class="">As noise approaches threshold, required redundancy diverges.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8012-b65e-dadd4bb36e67" class="">Thus in late cosmological epochs (e.g., heat death trend), redundancy becomes prohibitively expensive.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8095-bf32-fc7a6f1b7540" class="">This links cosmology directly to record fragility.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803f-bca6-ef141ba0cf9b"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b3-9ba5-f091c81472de" class="">4) Recursion Ceiling Is Control-Theoretic, Not Just Thermodynamic</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806c-a074-df14dbdadc5e" class="">Let delay in meta-update be .</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8005-a923-e98d80bbe8f3" class="">Discrete stability condition (linearized):</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a8-98a5-f6977ffdd5e1" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
|\alpha_d e^{-i\omega \tau_d}| &lt; 1</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800c-b15e-cb349d1a9fab" class="">As recursion depth increases, delay increases.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f5-b250-ffd7c574275c" class="">Even with infinite energy, delay-induced instability can cap recursion depth.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dc-b7bd-c641b104abb9" class="">This is rarely discussed in cosmological cognition arguments.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801c-8eef-e2246cc4b290"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8020-9d88-d130a195372e" class="">5) Horizon Structure as Accessibility Constraint</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8014-8b0f-f9fc1ba04647" class="">Even if total universe entropy is enormous, what matters is accessible entropy.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8032-8c12-f54b96496d51" class="">Accessible region bounded by particle horizon:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e9-91c1-ce996d200f68" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
R_H = \frac{c}{H}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d8-8d60-fb69d248c158" class="">Maximum accessible entropy:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809e-9fa1-fd81d2afbc9d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{access} \sim R_H^2</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8072-bafd-da632fd19165" class="">Thus recursion depth ceiling depends on cosmological expansion rate.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8004-a638-e5cee56628d5" class="">If dark energy dominates:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800d-b93f-ee3dde82fcde" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
H \to const \Rightarrow S_{access} \to const</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d1-a1ad-e67bbc5f6130" class="">Recursion depth becomes asymptotically bounded.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806d-8c4e-ee09e17e067d"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8066-bcfa-fad11cb55d1d" class="">6) The Deeper Arrow: Compression Direction</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8099-8c5a-c0bf079e61ea" class="">Earlier we defined entropy increase.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802e-9bcc-d35d3327bf13" class="">More precisely:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802f-991f-c7a2ef6d40d3" class="">The arrow is the direction in which macrodescriptions become shorter relative to microdescriptions.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803b-aaec-f987fc46dfad" class="">Define compression ratio:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800f-b239-dc5f50b504d7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\chi(t) = \frac{K_{macro}(t)}{K_{micro}(t)}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8050-b295-d54b61b39a7a" class="">Arrow condition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fe-98a7-f69bec50d540" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{d}{dt} \left( \text{stable compressible trace volume} \right) &gt; 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dd-a6f5-da6b6ce5c0c1" class="">Entropy gradient enables compressibility.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a8-9611-da317f136b6e" class="">This reframes time’s arrow in algorithmic terms.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8067-862b-ec21aaba8756"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80be-9fb6-c970b51c9781" class="">7) Complete Inequality Chain (Fully Closed)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803e-b2d8-f53ff0bdfacb" class="">Low Weyl at</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8068-ad33-e3eec57bbd90" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Rightarrow S_{grav}(t_0) \text{ minimal}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801f-b835-f9550cf1edfa" class="">Minimal gravitational entropy</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a7-af07-fa4da2e6a197" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Rightarrow Long-lived gradients</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b3-82cd-fbee4ed09c91" class="">Long-lived gradients</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80db-a1e4-ff05fca0fefd" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Rightarrow Stable redundancy growth</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802e-bdfe-ee631bf3e37c" class="">Stable redundancy growth</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e9-b168-cdb8c191cc17" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Rightarrow Recursion depth increases</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805d-b08e-f69ef1362a79" class="">Recursion depth limited by:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801c-b48b-fbc368a877b3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
P \ge kT\ln 2 \cdot \dot B(D)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8033-a0ab-ea1ee33d5fc0" class="">and</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8021-a3ae-c0b557bcfd34" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I_{records}(D) \le I_{max}(H)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801f-999d-c53c6f2bea5c" class="">and</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d8-ac00-d3641384a2e0" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">

Argument)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8017-bb3f-e43c04a026f1" class="">The central axis of the reasoning is:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806a-879b-dfb8aaddc94b" class="">The universe is a dissipative system in which total entropy increases, yet local “islands of order” (stars, planets, chemistry, life, brains, civilizations) can form because of energy gradients and the ability to export entropy to the environment.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8071-be6d-d04b227bfd1b" class="">What is non-obvious is not that entropy increases.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805f-a93b-dd12716455ef" class="">What is non-obvious is that the universe began in a configuration that allowed an enormous reserve of structure-forming potential — specifically, very low initial gravitational entropy, meaning that free gravitational degrees of freedom (Weyl curvature) were strongly suppressed.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f4-be2f-cc01188766db" class="">This initial condition allowed gradients to persist long enough to accumulate stable records and build stacked layers of modeling (meta-recursion).</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80bd-bc8e-e3fff6beaaf8"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8095-b5bb-fae329c488a1" class="">The Most Overlooked Point</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a6-af24-c7e0274f40b3" class="">It means:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8067-acd2-c4da52213ddd" class="">Free gravitational degrees of freedom (Weyl curvature) were suppressed nearly to zero.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805e-828a-d34cfafd3de6" class="">This is a boundary constraint on the geometric structure of spacetime at the initial moment.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8066-9763-ed7b87c8ea2b" class="">It is not merely a “thermal” or intuitive notion of order.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8075-973b-daa3c06e7fad" class="">When Weyl curvature is nearly zero:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d6-af56-d4bd226e7721" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">The universe is statistically special.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800f-881b-e80346af24cf" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">It is dynamically unstable enough for perturbations to grow.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8009-bac6-e7af97696834" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">It does not collapse immediately because expansion counteracts gravitational amplification.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d8-97b9-caf5d46c281b" class="">This balance allows long-lived gradients.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d5-a1bc-d3b0fc258330"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 m_{t+1} = \mathcal{U}(m_t, y_t; k_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8004-8820-d7a1e296d01b" class="">Policy:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dc-a39c-db29bfcecacc" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
u_t = \pi(m_t, x_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c0-90c6-e09f8b374554" class="">Civilizational self-modeling:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f6-b8b1-d03ff4b23213" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
C_{t+1} = F(C_t, Model(C_t))</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8093-a531-f27c21441e6d" class="">Complexity condition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802f-ab88-f637fd112500" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{d\,Cap(m_t,k_t)}{dt} \ge \frac{d\,C_t}{dt}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c0-a127-dd2a335fe0f3"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fa-b113-f4c340cceb0f" class="">C) Self-Reference Limits (Gödel-Type)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8023-a5dd-cf6c3396976b" class="">Structural template:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8056-b97e-ecab0b18bfd0" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
Consistent(F) \Rightarrow \exists G: True(G) \land \neg Provable_F(G)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80cc-a11e-cd47802fc3db" class="">Containment constraint:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a4-b751-d06f7a0632cf" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
T \subset U,\quad M \subset U,\quad M \neq U</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d9-9f51-cfb3c9a31dc0" class="">A model cannot equal the universe it models.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8012-8daa-cf26424de650"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8075-8818-cff3f4d8f021" class="">D) Gravity and Weyl Suppression</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e3-8095-fbad528e297b" class="">Riemann decomposition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8003-a075-e3c5587712ce" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
R_{abcd} = C_{abcd} + \left(g_{a[c}R_{d]b}-g_{b[c}R_{d]a}\right) - \frac{1}{3}R\, g_{a[c}g_{d]b}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8066-bef1-fe9ec33dc0f8" class="">FLRW case:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c2-92c2-e3e25b223252" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
C_{abcd} = 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805c-897f-da7d9a9cee91" class="">Weyl ratio proxy:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807d-9080-fd326f93326e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathcal{W} = \frac{C_{abcd}C^{abcd}}{R_{ef}R^{ef}}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808d-bbbf-c85c9c88e2a4" class="">Gravitational entropy proxy:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8056-bd51-dafdd6219993" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{\text{grav}} \sim \int_{\Sigma_t} f(C_{abcd}C^{abcd})\, dV</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807b-8876-d5bcec6256aa" class="">Initial condition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8041-be2c-c80f94b7782d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{grav}^{early} \ll S_{grav}^{today}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808b-b267-c53964b788a2"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8017-8e4e-f1d713ca01a8" class="">E) Structure Formation</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8077-a2d5-ecab2e817617" class="">Density perturbation growth:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c8-a756-c77b4210b546" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\ddot{\delta} + 2H\dot{\delta} - 4\pi G\rho\,\delta = 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807e-b3ac-df4fb6ac849f" class="">Balance condition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8041-8711-c97684acd22e" class="">Expansion damps growth, gravity amplifies.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ee-827f-e3584a358257"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806f-a16f-e6e17cfe3362" class="">F) Arrow of Time and Records</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8026-ba14-f9ccc45ce921" class="">Coarse-grained entropy:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8079-9015-fe593a8d028b" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{\text{cg}}(t) = -k\sum_i p_i(t)\ln p_i(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800f-ada4-f0ee9d1cb865" class="">Redundancy:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801b-ba7b-fbbb7fda6ea3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I(S:E_i)=H(S)+H(E_i)-H(S,E_i)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8060-8720-c61515e4e139" class="">Redundant record count:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d5-b036-f3b9c4c322d9" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
R_\theta(S:E) = \max \{N: I(S:E_i)\ge \theta\}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802d-bdcb-f6b6b05d2b46" class="">Operational arrow:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8005-b9ca-ed4b9fb08ce4" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{d}{dt}R_\theta(S:E) &gt; 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8038-af75-c662455ceb8f"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a4-b66b-e467e6050fef" class="">G) Past Hypothesis</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8091-9e16-fcfd39cd934c" class="">Initial condition restriction:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8000-b84f-cf69996a8c39" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
x(t_0)\in \Gamma_{PH}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8021-b68a-cfa6f17624a9" class="">Conditional measure:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b0-94bc-f0dd1896d374" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mu(\cdot \mid \Gamma_{PH}) = \frac{\mu(\cdot \cap \Gamma_{PH})}{\mu(\Gamma_{PH})}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c3-b2d3-f647cf916f6f"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e7-9014-e07e62803373" class="">H) Recursion Depth Dynamics</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803b-b5a0-ef7816a98f50" class="">Error per layer:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dd-b43a-c0c6bf99b646" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\varepsilon^{(d)}_t = \|m^{(d)}_t - \mathcal{T}^{(d)}_t\|</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a4-8f17-f2d3b5532d6e" class="">Update:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8019-8308-fdb9f8eae6f9" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\varepsilon^{(d)}_{t+1} = \alpha_d \varepsilon^{(d)}_t + \eta_d(t) - r_d(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8047-9de7-c626560c197f" class="">Stability:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8050-a236-f4385f51d7bb" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathbb{E}[r_d] \ge \mathbb{E}[\eta_d] + (\alpha_d - 1)\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon^{(d)}]</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8077-b0ac-ffce52fa8654"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c8-acae-c95d01d50e27" class="">I) Information Cost and Cosmic Bounds</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ae-8d4d-e94a599a62cd" class="">Landauer:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802b-afe1-d665a49505a2" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
E_{\min} = kT\ln 2</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8085-a1dc-edfe3ce68eaa" class="">Power constraint:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e7-ac9a-f42f499839ca" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
P_{\min}(D) \ge kT\ln 2 \cdot \dot B(D)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8075-a39a-de4af4afb1fc" class="">Bekenstein bound:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a1-b25a-f6373eb1b2ef" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S \le \frac{2\pi k E R}{\hbar c}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8050-b969-f0663ee91de2" class="">de Sitter horizon entropy:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806a-bc5a-fff028b1e1c0" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{dS} = \frac{\pi k}{\ell_p^2}\left(\frac{c}{H}\right)^2</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a2-a854-f8459b722642" class="">Information ceiling:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80be-b7c2-e756f44dbf83" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I_{\max} \propto \frac{1}{H^2}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8019-9b41-ccc76b2953a5" class="">Recursion feasibility:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e6-994b-f85dd45e35dc" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
P_{\text{available}} \ge kT\ln 2\cdot \dot B(D)
\quad\text{and}\quad
I_{\max} \ge I_{\text{records}}(D)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8044-ae91-f0045411212e"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8083-95d8-d24f265fb7ef" class="">Core Causal Chain</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c3-98cf-ea47c9ab000d" class="">Low Weyl at <br/>→ Low gravitational entropy<br/>→ Long-lived gradients<br/>→ Record accumulation<br/>→ Self-reference<br/>→ Recursion depth<br/>→ Horizon-bounded ceiling</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8068-83c0-d31ae40ecbd2"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ef-82c8-ca71f62d637f" class="">If you want to go further technically, choose:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ce-b088-ecfd4c43b33a" class="">A — Normalize everything into a closed discrete state system with explicit collapse thresholds.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80de-8a15-f308e0044138" class="">B — Write a minimal axiom system and formally derive:<br/>- Arrow of time = direction of record accumulation<br/>- Recursion depth ceiling = Landauer + Bekenstein + horizon limits</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8049-8782-ffa1da6a1a84" class="">More: close the remaining “gaps” as hard gates + equations (so AMOS can terminate Valid/Bounded/Invalid)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801a-b12e-c740c5cb5d48"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8041-ae36-c75b02883e8e" class="">1) Meta-Law layer (the missing top constraint)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b2-964a-d59cc5f49d09" class="">ML1) Conservation of accountability</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f1-87d2-eb6db616a5c1" class="">Every output  must be attributable to an input set  and transform chain :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80db-85ce-cd8e3e6ef8be" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\pi(o)=\langle I,\ T\rangle,\quad \text{and}\quad h(o)=\text{sha256}(h(I)\Vert h(T))</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8071-8ec3-f32e3c623e26" class="">ML2) No free universal claims</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8031-82a1-da7c3330ba43" class="">Any universal claim  must be either:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8080-a0d5-e8c4a1d25478" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><strong>Primitive</strong> (explicitly tagged), or</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ef-8723-d53e5f0e4d8f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><strong>Empirical with scope</strong>,</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8001-a68b-dcc18fc8a0ee" class="">Formally, forbid:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8020-942a-fd9bb9b4f460" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\forall x\in \Omega:\ \phi(x)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807d-9b19-fb93ddfc0448"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8099-851b-dfc1aca073a5" class="">2) Intangible / nonlocal claims without hand-waving (turn into testable invariants)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801b-bcfc-c562a3d7045e" class="">You can include “non-mainstream channels” only as <strong>Model-bounded</strong> hypotheses with explicit observables.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ae-aaca-c95e3842d255" class="">IN1) Hypothesis wrapper</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8023-afa8-e48fd92c2e8b" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
H_k:\ \exists S_k(t)\ \text{(latent channel)}\ \text{s.t.}\ Y(t)=g(S_k(t),Z(t))+\epsilon(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808e-a5ce-d12366ffa1b7" class="">IN2) Nonlocality proxy = predictive advantage under sensor ablations</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a1-82ca-c5355f88a8cd" class="">If a claim implies information access beyond known channels, enforce:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8011-806a-db50f2447d1c" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">remove known channels (WiFi, RF logs, audio, visual, etc.)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8028-bfd9-fa4b7b24b3f7" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">test if residual predictive power persists</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8023-b2ea-e9f0ca248577" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
IG_{oos}(S_k \mid Z\ \text{ablated})&gt;\tau</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8042-8600-ceb652d7d5b8" class=""><strong>Gate</strong>: any “intangible” claim must either pass ablation tests or be BOUNDED.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ef-adf8-e68d64391521"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8063-894f-c75d0410fbbf" class="">3) Electromagnetic layer (missing formalization)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d3-9060-ec1082938eb2" class="">EM1) Observable EM feature family</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80bd-b9f9-dfe735263a2d" class="">For sampled EM stream , derive:</p></div><div dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8052-b3b0-e974bdaf3f09" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">spectral centroid</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8072-8323-e0ee54326980" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">coherence between sensors</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg=="
