id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8000-9799-f1eda007c877" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
P_b(t)=\int_{f\in b} | \mathcal{F}\{E\}(f,t)|^2 df</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f9-953b-f127ae4cd7fc" class="">\gamma_{ij}^2(f,t)=\frac{|S_{ij}(f,t)|^2}{S_{ii}(f,t)S_{jj}(f,t)}<br/></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808c-ad24-f3f2a4bc63b2" class="">EM2) Causal sanity check (avoid correlation traps)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8016-872b-d59a40d89d07" class="">If EM feature “predicts” , verify direction with lag scan:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808c-8165-cc20b91b5952" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\alpha(\ell)=\text{corr}(E(t-\ell),Y(t))</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800e-adaf-dfdc55cb808f"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ea-a2a3-ebc1d1c0da3a" class="">4) Visual + sound “stress test” done properly</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c7-9840-f65fec0ef94c" class="">VS1) Compression test (records = compressible traces)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805c-bfa6-d85bebf1192e" class="">Let  be compressed length with fixed compressor.<br/>For stream :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c3-8032-e764b6eec690" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{comp}(t)=1-\frac{L(X_{0:t})}{|X_{0:t}|}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c7-83d9-c2874d5d1da7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta \text{comp}(t) &gt; 0\ \ \text{and}\ \ IG_{oos}(X)&gt;\tau</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8040-b9bd-f59a3627dbe7" class="">VS2) Perturbation robustness</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807d-9be0-c4642c053cd9" class="">Apply controlled transforms : blur, pitch shift, time-stretch.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8064-9b0c-ecc51fbf2434" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta_T = |\hat{\alpha}(X)-\hat{\alpha}(T(X))|</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8011-9189-c878493a2ec8"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805d-9d88-d50311f6994a" class="">5) Cross-time / cross-space: multi-scale invariance (missing)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809d-a375-f17737a139ef" class="">MS1) Scale index</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806b-bbef-cfafaa4f548e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
s \in \{\text{sec},\text{min},\text{hour},\text{day},\text{year},\text{century}\}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805c-a0f3-dbca86c99199" class="">MS2) Scale-transfer penalty</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804d-bb95-da85a3f393c4" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta_{scale}=\text{Var}_{s}\big(\hat{\alpha}_s\big)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803b-8271-dd0a480bd640"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d2-873e-d703c963faf9" class="">6) Cross-species: shared kernel, explicit parameterization (no vague “same everywhere”)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ef-be89-d977ae1c7212" class="">Represent species  with parameters  in the same update law:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d5-861e-f24000394221" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
x_{t+1}=F(x_t,u_t,\epsilon_t;\theta_k)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8016-9eaf-e9b868ca6e1c" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Perf}(k_2\mid \theta_{k_1}) \ge \text{PerfMin}\ \ \text{or}\ \ \exists \theta_{k_2}\ \text{fit with bounded drift}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808c-a6e2-caf48b353ed0" class=""><strong>Gate</strong>: if parameters must change, you record <strong>what changed</strong> (no universal claim).</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809a-a800-f14f35574ddf"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8083-bae0-edda0b89de3e" class="">7) Forex: make AMOS a “most advanced” engine (bounded, deterministic, auditable)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802d-925a-f84aad8ea806" class="">7.1 Market microstructure core (must exist)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8016-89fa-f3abfa20de09" class="">FX1) Execution cost model</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8054-bd69-d6ebaee33f84" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">

\text{contr}(b_i,b_j)=\mathbf{1}\Big[\exists x \in \sigma_i\cap\sigma_j:\ \phi_i(x) \wedge \phi_j(x)\ \Rightarrow\ \bot\Big]</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8093-87ee-e0ca07a92cb9" class="">TS3) Resolution rule (deterministic)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8082-9672-d5284b5005e1" class="">If contradiction:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8043-8883-c81d8b76f4b0" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li>Prefer higher support rank (Empirical &gt; Inferential &gt; Definitional &gt; Model-bounded &gt; Primitive/Limit only if explicitly tagged)</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803b-a26f-f33e2e660b9b" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li>Prefer narrower scope match</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8078-86e2-d818d12a0b63" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li>Prefer higher out-of-sample score</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e1-ac9c-f3b7a254d43c" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li>If tie → keep both but mark <strong>BOUNDED</strong> and create Issue</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8013-8fda-fe3f68fb1f0d" class="">Update:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801b-a39a-e661be4b2713" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
w_i \leftarrow w_i \cdot (1-\lambda\cdot \text{contr})</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d9-8bec-f927772548c5" class=""><strong>Gate</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fe-920d-d28391a9c8b1" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\sum_{(i,j)} \text{contr}(b_i,b_j) = 0 \quad \text{for Valid termination}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c6-a122-c17fd4f407f4"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801d-9d5e-da52f53d2f20" class="">Causality layer (not correlation): invariance across interventions/regimes</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e8-9ff6-f987bd35da71" class="">C1) Invariance score across environments</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f3-a3ad-feba914154aa" class="">Let environments  (market regimes, venues, time windows, geographies).<br/>For signal  predicting target :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8042-8cbc-daa3ea7693f0" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\hat{\alpha}_e = \mathbb{E}[Y\mid S,e]</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ae-a461-f4f9704674cf" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta_{inv}(S)=\text{Var}_e(\hat{\alpha}_e)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8099-9d33-fb7715d85de3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta_{inv}(S) \le \tau_{inv}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8022-b450-efb501ed788b" class="">C2) Intervention test (FX)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8052-a06c-dc704de7285c" class="">When central bank intervention flag  occurs, require conditional robustness:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e3-a917-cde6095b313e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\hat{\alpha}^{(noI)} = \mathbb{E}[Y\mid S, I=0],\quad
\hat{\alpha}^{(I)} = \mathbb{E}[Y\mid S, I=1]</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8074-b54d-c281694d2be6" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
|\hat{\alpha}^{(noI)}-\hat{\alpha}^{(I)}| \le \tau_I</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b4-91b1-fc12d4ed841a" class="">C3) Do-operator proxy (when real interventions unavailable)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809c-88bf-c983bfcfdfbf" class="">Use “natural experiments”: spread spikes, venue outages, liquidity withdrawals.<br/>Define event . Require:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807d-8138-dc5719520646" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{sign}(\hat{\alpha})\ \text{stable under}\ E_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805d-b049-dca9c8bd6d45"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803c-b8f2-f2eab5ca0b75" class="">Leakage firewall (most common hidden failure): time + provenance constraints</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ce-9c9f-e84627c16215" class="">L1) Time index constraint</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8068-8d73-ceceef52d0ec" class="">Every feature  must be computed from information available at or before :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8044-bb62-e383d8363237" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\max(\text{timestamp}(\text{inputs}(f_t))) \le t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80da-8eb0-e1c61d80e414" class="">If violated → BLOCKER.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e9-a030-d396c3c8a79f" class="">L2) Provenance hash chain</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805e-9fa2-c1afdde96a71" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
h(f_t)=\text{sha256}\big(h(\text{inputs}) \Vert \text{transform\_id} \Vert \text{params}\big)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b5-9bc3-f30280ce2da0" class="">L3) Lookahead detector</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8010-85de-d99920c5479d" class="">For any feature, measure suspicious predictive jump near boundaries:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803f-bed5-dd0ecc92ce61" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
J = \text{AUC}_{\text{train}} - \text{AUC}_{\text{purged}}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f0-89e4-c5136e0fb62d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
J \le \tau_J</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8049-9ab4-cb997d0ea729"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809b-b8e3-cc6c4ff547c5" class="">Forensics + replay (required for “no gaps”): evidence chain for every decision</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8095-9782-cc6b1c76beeb" class="">F1) Decision record</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800a-b518-d40ba1d33e65" class="">At time :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8019-ad09-d1068da52025" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
d_t = (s_t,\ a_t,\ \hat{\alpha}_t,\ EC_t,\ \text{gates\_passed},\ \text{belief\_ids},\ \pi_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dc-8f39-f717eb16d2c2" class="">F2) Replay determinism</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ab-bfc2-ec81ea34b9f1" class="">Re-run must reproduce:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c1-8de7-e34c48b2d362" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
d_t^{(replay)} = d_t^{(orig)}\ \ \forall t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8040-a973-d25a105a977d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\sum_t \mathbf{1}[d_t^{(replay)}\neq d_t^{(orig)}]=0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800b-8a99-caafdff83123" class="">F3) Attribution</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b6-902f-f004ac25860d" class="">Contribution of each signal to action:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fa-99df-eb08a1ac1c72" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{contrib}_k(t)=\frac{\partial \text{score}(t)}{\partial S_k(t)}\cdot S_k(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802e-8b7c-d2f952b25a86"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804c-8cb2-e39fd9b82051" class="">Multimodal (visual/sound/EM) done correctly: predictive information + stability + ownership</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fc-be5a-e622eb961297" class="">M1) Mutual information gain (operational)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c6-9444-c24790ce7c57" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">

AS \le \tau_{AS}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f9-9cb5-f8b766cd60f3" class="">U3) Toxic Flow Detector (Order Flow Imbalance)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8048-89ac-e54bb049410a" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
OFI_t = \sum (\Delta \text{bid size}) - \sum (\Delta \text{ask size})</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d9-9f83-d4548b90958d" class="">Trade only when predicted edge dominates toxic flow:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80bd-ac50-cecd26df210b" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
|\hat{\alpha}_t| &gt; \lambda \cdot |OFI_t|</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8023-9d80-dd96f7de09ab"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8024-84ac-c34fa927390e" class="">V) Reflexivity Engine (your actions change the world)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d6-95b5-e01c4ac99c3d" class="">V1) Price Impact Feedback Loop</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8060-8dc1-cbd6e6676974" class="">Let midprice be:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8078-9da4-efb3c2be1bb5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
p_{t+1}=p_t + \eta \cdot \underbrace{\epsilon_t}_{\text{exogenous}} + \psi \cdot \underbrace{u_t}_{\text{your net flow}} + \xi_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807e-a82a-cedda4825aff" class="">Then your expected return must include self-impact:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804f-bbd0-f67ad4042a73" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathbb{E}[r_t] = \mathbb{E}[ \Delta p_t ] - \text{ImpactCost}(u_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f1-a1b1-c3855ba8ce54" class=""><strong>Gate</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806e-ad49-c2335a592549" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathbb{E}[\Delta p_t \mid u_t] - \text{ImpactCost}(u_t) &gt; 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e1-a9fe-c777c4d4cf42" class="">V2) Stability Condition (avoid positive feedback blowups)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8078-98eb-fb917e623514" class="">If your policy increases size when slippage increases, you have a positive feedback loop.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8009-a088-ef7f68c2874f" class="">Define sensitivity:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809a-8f73-fa35b463433f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
g = \frac{\partial u_t}{\partial \text{slippage}_t}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8056-9169-ee0c162f39ae" class=""><strong>Gate</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80da-b9a4-c26a50512d9a" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
g \le 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8025-87c9-e92a3a60bf54"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8058-a217-ddbee8a1a71c" class="">W) Macro-Contagion Matrix (cross-asset/cross-currency propagation)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ae-8567-e8074ea018f3" class="">W1) Contagion as a Dynamic Network</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808e-b8ed-d13acf92b9fd" class="">Nodes = instruments/currencies. Edge weights  represent transmission strength.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c6-8a69-f9fd1a912206" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
x_{t+1} = A_t x_t + \epsilon_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8082-9539-d0fe9b042fd8" class="">Where  = standardized stress/returns vector.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8045-aee6-dbaba628a92e" class=""><strong>Contagion Index</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fb-acf7-dbd1cbe8dfc8" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
CI_t = \rho(A_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805a-8c74-e5826255eb42" class=""><strong>Gate</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807a-a70c-f762442763f8" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
CI_t &lt; 1 \quad \text{(stable regime)}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803b-85f9-f8a7da3108bf" class="">If , reduce risk or switch playbook.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80aa-b26c-fc12a4a536c2" class="">W2) Shock Amplification</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806c-af33-f406989c6a50" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Amplify}_t = \frac{\|x_{t+k}\|}{\|x_t\|}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80bf-b789-c96db17c3fbc" class=""><strong>Gate</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8058-803d-f509c12d459e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Amplify}_t \le \tau_{amp}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8021-bf1c-fdaf6bc0eaae"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8080-86d6-c3b06ea9c722" class="">X) Central Bank / Macro Reaction Function Layer (FX-specific)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8012-941b-d417ef74b842" class="">X1) Reaction Function (policy rate response)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8066-ae04-e4e104f09ee8" class="">Toy but useful:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8070-83b6-ddb0e9ec9882" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta i_t = a(\pi_t-\pi^*) + b(y_t - y^*) + c \cdot \text{FXStress}_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8077-a01f-d28c8c8302e8" class="">FX forward expectation:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8056-acad-d06e33838dc7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathbb{E}[\Delta s_{t\to t+k}] \approx (i_t - i^*_t) - \text{RiskPremium}_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8056-8417-e100b7c35708" class=""><strong>Gate</strong><br/>Trade directional FX only when policy differential signal dominates risk premium uncertainty:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800d-a002-f20a5f7630ff" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
|(i_t - i^*_t)| &gt; \lambda \cdot \sigma(\text{RiskPremium})</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ca-9141-e6070ec00021" class="">X2) Intervention Probability Model</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e3-8f1f-f0fc13325733" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
P(\text{intervene}_t) = \sigma\left(\alpha + \beta \cdot |\Delta s| + \gamma \cdot \text{vol} + \delta \cdot \text{level}\right)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806b-b030-f499f9cff585" class=""><strong>Gate</strong><br/>If  high → disable trend-following, cap exposure.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80bc-bf5e-ff1d1019f100"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d5-800b-f92446fc2368" class="">Y) Execution Microstructure Engine (real edge dies here)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8076-9090-c1041d91dd92" class="">Y1) Spread + Depth Feasibility</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8072-8f32-ffb5672f72f6" class="">Let spread , depth , your size .</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8074-9d5b-cd46b5661520" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
