These are not cosmetic features. These are failure-prevention subsystems.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8040-9760-ee151840367f" class="">I will keep this concrete and equational.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b9-a71a-eb09683b7ba3"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8097-abda-de3ed8ffce15" class="">N) Structural Fragility Controls (rarely implemented correctly)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fa-9eeb-e81dd005cb90"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803c-acea-cc2a65442060" class="">N1) Parameter Instability Detection (Overfitting Drift Monitor)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801b-8b53-e30a40fb492c" class="">Most systems fail because optimal parameters are not stable across windows.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8059-b786-d523693b45de" class="">Let  be parameter vector estimated on window .</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802e-99ef-e9198bca44b7" class="">Define parameter drift norm:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ba-866a-e34ee126c854" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta_\theta(t) = \|\theta_t - \theta_{t-1}\|</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8098-8b98-dfc4a5d2c5c9" class="">Define stability ratio:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8006-b828-fd22461589d3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_\theta = \frac{\text{mean performance across windows}}{\text{std}(\theta_t)}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8075-adce-e6da81eab4be" class="">Gate:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e8-8649-f952060df1e9" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta_\theta(t) \le \tau_\theta</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803f-b89d-d3ad202c8355" class="">If parameters jump wildly but performance is flat → model likely overfitting.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8024-8153-f43707d8edf8" class=""><strong>Files</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e9-a2cc-ded431f7b95e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>03_IMMUNE/validation/parameter_stability.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d3-afe8-c2a4fe2016de" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>17_OS/metrics.py</code> (add drift index)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8079-96ab-cc072118cd1f"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ac-b052-e02aa49ed687" class="">N2) Structural Alpha Decomposition</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8079-a2c9-e3f9647825f8" class="">Decompose returns into:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e0-8390-fb80611ab7a4" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
r_t = \alpha_t + \beta_t r_{m,t} + \epsilon_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8020-91e3-de001abc26ad" class="">Where:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8049-ba4d-e3dc97833ecf" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">= market factor</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ef-9303-c97b01969b54" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">= residual structural edge</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8024-9ec8-c05abbc18933" class="">Gate:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808a-a9c5-f3111844f603" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathbb{E}[\alpha] &gt; 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807d-aecf-c0ddf5c6a311" class="">and</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ca-8082-d957725ed52c" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{\mathbb{E}[\alpha]}{\sigma(\alpha)} &gt; S_{\min}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8076-b478-daf804fc9cfd" class="">If alpha disappears after cost attribution → system has no real edge.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d6-8334-e1c7b516f385"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80af-9c28-ee5b813efec8" class="">N3) Tail Exposure Quantification (Extreme Risk)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e5-a04b-cbe30d3d7488" class="">Expected Shortfall:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8081-9e25-d305f19816f7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
ES_\alpha = \mathbb{E}[R \mid R \le VaR_\alpha]</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8033-9d3b-e6a3626bdeae" class="">Gate:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8031-bea9-f1dedc48fe77" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
ES_{0.99} \ge -X\%</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dc-84f6-f5fde9fd5c6b" class="">And tail convexity exposure:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8029-8360-e67f68d8ad2e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\kappa = \frac{\partial^2 PnL}{\partial \sigma^2}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c4-8796-e4dd2611d832" class="">Negative convexity in stress regime → structural fragility.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fb-bc8f-e1ceaee726c8"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a1-b918-c5ae582d967e" class="">N4) Liquidity Slippage Impact Model</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808e-b57d-e885bbf13e2f" class="">Market impact approximation:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c3-9c31-f525cbfcf8c9" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Impact}(Q) = \gamma \cdot \sigma \sqrt{\frac{Q}{V}}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805e-839b-e9ed696157e8" class="">Where:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8028-a07d-f385af5ad9d2" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">= order size</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f4-8a4d-edaf373a2767" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">= volume</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806b-8798-ddb882a2e49b" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">= volatility</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8009-86bf-ef211fa37d5c" class="">Gate:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801c-bfef-f48e55d47cd5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Impact}(Q) &lt; \tau_{impact}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8019-b92f-ea52acb318f3" class="">Prevents scaling into illiquid conditions.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8098-b3b7-fe2c449de59e"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800d-9579-d50a22d6506e" class="">O) Prediction Layer Upgrades</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8019-83bc-f39bac33120e"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8040-b185-c610de43fd4d" class="">O1) Entropy of Prediction Distribution</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8038-b5cf-eb97706f7f34" class="">If predictive model outputs probability distribution :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8013-877a-ed944de9c15e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
H(p) = -\sum p_i \log p_i</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dc-8bf4-fa4775d2a04f" class="">Low entropy = confident prediction.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809c-81e8-dc7f365828b4" class="">Gate:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8047-8292-cff2d238b604" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
H(p_t) &lt; H_{max}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ac-8637-fc834fcd2e10" class="">Avoid trading when prediction uncertainty too high.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ed-b741-df0783cc6f62"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807f-8f2e-ee89d0be98c0" class="">O2) Calibration Score (Brier / ECE)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8047-9dcb-d098af8d8073" class="">Brier Score:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d1-8051-eb0905515beb" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
BS = \frac{1}{N} \sum (p_i - y_i)^2</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8031-a70b-f3abaab6de88" class="">Expected Calibration Error:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ba-b8f1-c79756949bdd" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
ECE = \sum_k \frac{|B_k|}{N} |\text{acc}(B_k) - \text{conf}(B_k)|</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b7-9ca1-c602e251ab46" class="">Gate:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ea-822b-fbf6254b9096" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
ECE \le \tau_{cal}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b7-968a-e32e366d3d45"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8044-90c4-fddb0e28897f" class="">O3) Predictive Information Gain</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8035-b2c7-f82f6c9654ad" class="">Information gain over baseline:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f4-9981-e3dbe657a1a9" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
IG = H(Y) - H(Y \mid X)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8082-80c5-cc75209d0cb6" class="">If  → model adds no signal.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8024-b946-dab910c6ec6d"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f5-bf62-d8a6e087420f" class="">P) Self-Correction Layer (Meta-Agent Hardening)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80de-b504-d8756b35b98e"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f4-9272-cb90f8ff9ae5" class="">P1) Strategy Performance Decay Detector</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804f-b72f-f1da5d1032c8" class="">Rolling Sharpe decay:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80af-9656-e19c1c78d773" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta S = S_{recent} - S_{long}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e6-8223-dc90cc5c93ba" class="">Gate:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805c-8dd6-eb181c2c1b23" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta S \ge -\tau_S</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8071-a764-e8f0fcfe3228" class="">If violated → reduce exposure.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e3-943a-cb5bdadd3dc5"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a8-abbd-cdfe2c64e4a3" class="">P2) Learning Budget Constraint</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8025-b835-ea2825598495" class="">Training must not overfit beyond complexity bound:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e9-86fa-ff6c10f0ddb7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Complexity penalty} = \lambda \cdot \|\theta\|_2^2</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ac-8c95-c15e49e4fcbf" class="">Objective:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f6-b818-c452ff79be95" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\max \left( \mathbb{E}[R] - \lambda \|\theta\|^2 \right)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801b-b6c9-f39d89831aaf"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808e-94a8-feb8a73fc981" class="">P3) Regime-Aware Model Switching</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8012-851b-e6af60f47692" class="">Hidden state</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8089-8fe4-f7ecae9fed60" class="">Transition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e7-aeed-c79e3505e483" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
P(z_{t+1}=j \mid z_t=i)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8080-8d9f-ff2215e18316" class="">Conditional model:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d0-a53a-db0f7df058ea" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
r_t \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_{z_t}, \sigma_{z_t})</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8062-ba52-c5db60b91844" class="">Switch models based on posterior regime probability.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801f-9ff4-ec5973b89f16"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804d-98be-e3a0fc271852" class="">Q) Infrastructure Hardening</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8084-a577-eee3f1d17e28"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8044-9abe-ecb08a1dafaa" class="">Q1) Deterministic Replay Engine</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d9-99a9-cb254cd14e9b" class="">Every build run must be replayable:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8076-921e-e0ffaf0067b7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{hash}(code) + \text{hash}(data) + \text{hash}(config)
\Rightarrow \text{identical output}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a8-af8c-f4d79755bafa" class="">Add hash chain log:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fd-986d-eb5fbda75b1d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
H_{run} = \text{sha256}(H_{prev} + \text{current_state})</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80cc-a555-f30ee02aacaf"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8050-a98d-e86276d7e0eb" class="">Q2) Kill Switch Logic</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8052-bda7-ea414d8262ed" class="">If cumulative drawdown exceeds threshold:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8073-adc3-d994fc42de1b" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
DD_t = \max_{s&lt;t} P_s - P_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8077-a3f8-d2a65abb5d0e" class="">Gate:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800c-ac3e-f087b1f397ba" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
DD_t \ge DD_{max} \Rightarrow w_t = 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8093-8c66-c496e7e98c12"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c9-8b5c-e589fcfde867" class="">Q3) Exposure Gradient Limiter</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ec-9eb8-d34ecd4fd96b" class="">Limit change in position:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8030-8ffd-c2da76fc826b" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
|w_t - w_{t-1}| \le \delta_{max}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e7-b3a1-f35d7b6bf5cf" class="">Prevents impulsive scaling.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e0-9a63-d7736611f6c9"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ad-b420-d8397c30affc" class="">R) Long-Horizon Constraints</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803c-abbc-f9c194231653"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805c-b88c-dfb98ec4e4ed" class="">R1) Capital Growth Sustainability</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ba-a8f4-ecbc9132df3e" class="">Kelly fraction:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8054-baae-c2fd62c400b3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
f^* = \frac{\mu}{\sigma^2}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803c-a857-e33f0e2d404b" class="">But use fractional Kelly:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8092-9174-f4fb543fa032" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
f = c \cdot f^*, \quad c &lt; 1</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806f-9ad2-d2df6909ac39"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f8-9d3b-c50d8b968120" class="">R2) Compounding Stability</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808d-b8f9-d2cb846a1e70" class="">Geometric growth:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8014-acc6-f759fc5b4448" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
G = \exp\left( \mathbb{E}[\log(1+r)] \right)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b1-bd44-f06c48677223" class="">Maximize log-growth, not arithmetic return.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ea-b0af-d525d81d5a4d"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b3-b150-fdd9732d60e3" class="">S) Cognitive-Digital Twin Expansion (if you’re building self-model)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8045-b909-c0508752face"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8010-98ef-e1bca0c3a4d2" class="">S1) Belief Update Equation (Bayesian Form)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805b-9b4a-ef653a8162d7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">

TC_t = \frac{s_t}{2} + \text{slip}_t + fee</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808f-81ff-c47ee04a8a12" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
s_t = \bar s_{(sess,instr)}\cdot \exp(\lambda_1 z^{vol}_t + \lambda_2 z^{liq}_t + \epsilon_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d0-afac-d901f1933e7b" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{slip}_t = \kappa \cdot |q_t|^\eta \cdot \sigma_t \cdot \exp(\nu_1 z^{news}_t + \nu_2 z^{gap}_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805f-95b7-cfd597398914" class=""><strong>Files</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f1-a7d0-cf5a169b222a" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>08_WORLD_MODEL/models/equations/microstructure.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8006-8112-f448c4952f7b" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>04_MOTOR_SYSTEM/execution_engine/cost_model.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807a-837d-cd1f45f9f4d6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>07_METABOLISM/ingestion_pipeline/session_stats.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80df-a863-e99044001df7"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8013-853c-febefda36340" class="">A2) Latency + adverse selection penalty</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802d-a41b-c2149476fc29" class="">If you place at time  and fill at :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806a-82bd-ff85a8e4d496" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta p^{adv}_t = \mathbb{E}[p_{t+d}-p_t \mid \text{trade direction}]</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8081-be47-e147e85a3d08" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
AS_t = \text{sign}(q_t)\cdot \Delta p^{adv}_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e0-8849-ccb51f79d985" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
r^{net}_t = r_t - TC_t - AS_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ad-8e54-c6ca9cbe1bdd" class=""><strong>Files</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8006-a124-eabbffdfd50f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>04_MOTOR_SYSTEM/execution_engine/adverse_selection.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8049-b579-e434cb076460" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>04_MOTOR_SYSTEM/task_runner/stress.py</code> (latency sweeps)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8059-8066-c77e60461297"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h1 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fd-bcef-eed8ce24853c" class="">B) Signal Stack (multi-scale, multi-regime, strictly causal)</h1></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d6-aa5e-debeb46df8bf" class="">B1) Core causal feature library (must be DSL-safe)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8070-99e4-de3ae3672947" class="">Returns:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80cc-b1ee-d7eb0350202f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
r_t=\ln\left(\frac{p_t}{p_{t-1}}\right)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8098-91c4-fa66636c43b7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\sigma^2_t = (1-\alpha)\sigma^2_{t-1}+\alpha r_t^2</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809b-a824-d007e01bc543" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\beta_t=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{w}(i-\bar i)(\ln p_{t-w+i}-\overline{\ln p})}{\sum_{i=1}^{w}(i-\bar i)^2}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dd-b8d3-fdebc205e4c3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
z_t=\frac{\ln p_t-\mu_t}{\sigma_t+\epsilon}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8057-bc9d-f104e9096394" class=""><strong>Files</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c1-a832-c14082468d71" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>08_WORLD_MODEL/models/DSL/nodes.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803c-b684-f5e5d280c3e1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>08_WORLD_MODEL/models/equations/features.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b8-8885-c07e82f57173" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>08_WORLD_MODEL/models/validators/causality.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a9-b87c-dd778f177c01"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805a-933e-fe3beea02cbe" class="">B2) Regime inference (explicit, deterministic, no ML required)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a6-ba6a-e7ff2a28288a" class="">Define regime state :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d6-959a-c4b56dbce220" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
z_t=\arg\max_k\ \text{score}_k(\phi_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8048-b2ea-f6344c6de0d4" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Shock if</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803b-8664-f62cbf338a02" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Trend if and ADX proxy high</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8058-b712-d8144e2937da" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Else Range</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a8-8e3e-c36218dfc9f5" class="">Position gating:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805e-8c57-d5d2e81b16e5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
w_t \leftarrow w_t \cdot g(z_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8033-946e-f8841a35aaad" class=""><strong>Files</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802b-901a-ec0292d0d35f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>08_WORLD_MODEL/models/equations/regime.py</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f8-9427-ca3c30c4ffd4" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>03_IMMUNE/constraints/risk.py</code> (shock gate)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8020-8800-de13e38d493e"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8082-967f-ca01b90a3076" class="">B3) Cross-asset FX structure (triangular consistency residual)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801b-93e6-c6fce7592bb9" class="">For currencies :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8098-acf9-c7a319db58a1" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
