id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80df-a842-fb7ff9065762" class="">Tóm tắt các “phát hiện” (theo mạch lập luận xuyên suốt)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e3-95d9-f680dc53aa8c" class="">Trục lõi của toàn bộ chuỗi lập luận là: vũ trụ là một hệ tiêu tán (dissipative) trong đó entropy toàn cục tăng, nhưng các “đảo trật tự” cục bộ (sao, hành tinh, hoá học, sự sống, não bộ, văn minh) có thể hình thành nhờ các gradient năng lượng và khả năng xuất entropy ra môi trường. Cái “không hiển nhiên” không phải là việc entropy tăng, mà là vũ trụ đã khởi đầu ở một cấu hình cho phép tồn tại một “dự trữ khả năng hình thành cấu trúc” cực lớn, tức entropy hấp dẫn ban đầu thấp (đặc biệt là các bậc tự do hấp dẫn tự do bị triệt tiêu mạnh). Từ đó, các gradient kéo dài đủ lâu để tích luỹ “bản ghi” (records) và xây lớp mô hình chồng lớp (meta-recursion).</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8027-ab5d-cce5b1253306" class="">Điểm bị bỏ qua nhiều nhất là: “entropy hấp dẫn ban đầu thấp” không chỉ có nghĩa “mật độ trơn/smooth”, mà còn là “các bậc tự do hấp dẫn tự do (Weyl curvature) bị ức chế gần như về 0”. Đây là một ràng buộc biên (boundary constraint) lên cấu trúc hình học của không–thời gian ở thời điểm đầu, chứ không chỉ là một trạng thái “nhiệt” hay “trật tự” theo trực giác thường. Khi Weyl gần như bằng 0, vũ trụ vừa “đặc biệt” (ít khả dĩ theo thống kê nếu lấy ngẫu nhiên) vừa “đủ bất ổn động lực” để các nhiễu nhỏ có thể lớn lên dưới hấp dẫn, nhưng lại không sụp đổ tức thì—nhờ sự giằng co giữa hấp dẫn khuếch đại và giãn nở làm tắt dần.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fd-91c3-d0fa9462c2fd" class="">Mũi tên thời gian, ở tầng sâu hơn khẩu hiệu “entropy tăng”, được quy về hướng mà “bản ghi ổn định” tích luỹ và trở nên dư thừa trong môi trường (nhiều bản sao độc lập). Động học vi mô có thể gần đối xứng thời gian, nhưng tính bất đối xứng vĩ mô xuất hiện khi ta áp đặt điều kiện biên entropy thấp ở quá khứ (Past Hypothesis) và khi cơ chế tạo–giữ bản ghi vận hành nhờ decoherence và sự mã hoá dư thừa. Nói cách khác: “hướng thời gian” có thể đọc trực tiếp bằng hướng mà thông tin về hệ được in dấu vào môi trường theo cách bền vững, chứ không chỉ bằng một đại lượng entropy trừu tượng.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f0-b7c2-fe242873e092" class="">Độ sâu đệ quy (recursion depth) — tức khả năng của một hệ xây mô hình về thế giới, rồi mô hình về cách cập nhật mô hình, rồi tiếp nữa — bị chặn không chỉ bởi “năng lượng hữu hạn”, mà bởi ba bó ràng buộc ít được nhấn mạnh: (i) chi phí sửa lỗi và xoá thông tin (Landauer) để giữ mô hình ổn định; (ii) giới hạn dung lượng thông tin tối đa trong một vùng hữu hạn (Bekenstein/holographic dạng “diện tích”); và (iii) cấu trúc chân trời vũ trụ (horizon) trong kịch bản giãn nở gia tốc, làm “tài nguyên khả dụng” hữu hạn dù vũ trụ có thể vô hạn toàn cục. Vì vậy, ngay cả khi kỹ thuật tối ưu, độ sâu đệ quy vẫn có trần do ngân sách sửa lỗi + dung lượng lưu bản ghi + khả năng tiếp cận tài nguyên bị chân trời giới hạn.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8028-9a6e-c9f85eaaba30"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d2-a93a-f00b46559b66" class="">Tóm tắt toàn bộ phương trình và quan hệ đã dùng (kèm ý nghĩa)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807f-a8d7-ca541ee1eebd" class="">A) Entropy và cân bằng tiêu tán</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8060-a598-dbb153e3da7a" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Định luật II (tổng quát):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805a-bfe3-c9704b90d882" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta S_{total} \ge 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8059-a579-c7022df69f8b" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Cân bằng entropy nội bộ (dạng ngân sách):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8062-9240-da34917c4fd4" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{internal}(t+1) = S_{internal}(t) + S_{generated} + S_{imported} - S_{exported}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801f-94b8-cc458fec7dd3" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Điều kiện sống còn của “đảo trật tự” (xuất entropy đủ):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8017-a438-f7a088f2c1e3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{generated} + S_{imported} \le S_{exported}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80bd-ae35-d9d4439a9c7b" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Biến thiên entropy nội (ký hiệu dạng dòng):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804e-bb83-f8e3a2754bc2" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta H_{int}(t) = H_{in}(t) + H_{gen}(t) - H_{out}(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801d-a184-ea95f761cbf7"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d5-93fa-c2721813e530" class="">B) Động lực meta-recursive (hệ + mô hình của hệ)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8086-a15c-fa1cd4b0d8c7" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Động lực trạng thái hệ:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a5-8d97-e4655aac2e93" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, e_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d1-94c5-e5dbbdefa30e" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Cập nhật mô hình (có meta-model chi phối luật cập nhật):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8035-9e05-fb62ab6d32c1" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
m_{t+1} = \mathcal{U}(m_t, y_t; k_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c8-8e57-cc9db1e4c3db" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Chính sách hành động dựa trên mô hình:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ed-9802-f6e539f0b0f6" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
u_t = \pi(m_t, x_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802d-a2ec-ca6af194a15e" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Động lực văn minh có mô hình (dạng tổng quát):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809b-8b0e-c11c813e7a84" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
C_{t+1} = F(C_t, Model(C_t))</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802d-b52d-c21db0692b52" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Mô tả “vũ trụ + mô hình nội tại” (dạng giả thuyết mạnh):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8091-b426-ff396bb450a8" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
U_{t+1} = F(U_t, M(U_t))</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807a-97d1-d46e41a97e34" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
U_{t+1} = F(U_t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80be-9a9d-f2a20663b19e" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Điều kiện “mô hình tăng kịp độ phức tạp môi trường”:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8027-b38c-cbcbbbb5ca8b" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{d\,Cap(m_t,k_t)}{dt} \ge \frac{d\,C_t}{dt}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8053-8c99-c73a603fce1d"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b5-8c64-fa51958f501a" class="">C) Tự tham chiếu và giới hạn hình thức (Gödel / tự mô tả)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804f-a869-f83b45f73bea" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Mẫu Gödel (dạng cấu trúc):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c9-a289-e8ece289df40" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
Consistent(F) \Rightarrow \exists G: True(G) \land \neg Provable_F(G)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806c-9062-d2a01314b330" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Ràng buộc chứa-trong (mô hình là một phần của vũ trụ):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8076-90bf-f002f12e413d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
T \subset U,\quad M \subset U,\quad M \neq U</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a0-a2d0-d7341b284ee7"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8087-9487-d61d8966c074" class="">D) Hấp dẫn: Weyl, “entropy hấp dẫn”, và điều kiện ban đầu</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a2-80a6-c99684a8a462" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Phân rã Riemann (Ricci + Weyl):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8060-a376-ff9683a2c862" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
R_{abcd} = C_{abcd} + \left(g_{a[c}R_{d]b}-g_{b[c}R_{d]a}\right) - \frac{1}{3}R\, g_{a[c}g_{d]b}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c4-bee3-d1c83842a6c1" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>FLRW có Weyl bằng 0:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804d-8101-d79fe57bacf0" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
C_{abcd} = 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f5-9f55-e6eff4922d72" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Tỉ lệ “Weyl/Ricci” (proxy cho mức “tự do hấp dẫn”):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ed-a6c2-c64bf3f2bfbc" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathcal{W} \equiv \frac{C_{abcd}C^{abcd}}{R_{ef}R^{ef}}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c9-8829-d620fae922d7" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Proxy entropy hấp dẫn (dạng tích phân theo hypersurface):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805a-8438-d76e3bde0909" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{\text{grav}} \sim \int_{\Sigma_t} f\!\left(C_{abcd}C^{abcd}\right)\, dV</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8046-98eb-c32f7f9a0f97" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Điều kiện “entropy hấp dẫn ban đầu thấp”:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803b-a079-c0aa6cbd0ba1" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{grav}^{early} \ll S_{grav}^{today}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807b-9403-ebc7a3f80f1f"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809d-be13-fc7470b24890" class="">E) Hình thành cấu trúc: giãn nở vs bất ổn hấp dẫn</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ee-bfa6-d25c23f8c423" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Phương trình tăng trưởng nhiễu loạn mật độ (tuyến tính, matter-dominated):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8069-93e4-f5196b8574fc" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\ddot{\delta} + 2H\dot{\delta} - 4\pi G\rho\,\delta = 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8030-bbf5-c0f1086c09dd" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\delta \equiv \frac{\delta\rho}{\rho},\quad H=\frac{\dot a}{a}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806c-8232-d5d701e81902" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Liên hệ Friedmann (dạng dùng để nhấn mạnh cân bằng giãn nở–mật độ):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8018-9735-e17c46ca3c50" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
H^2 \sim \frac{8\pi G}{3}\rho</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802a-a6bb-c542bbd7503a"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80aa-9d84-f3522c0045a9" class="">F) Mũi tên thời gian: coarse-graining và “hướng bản ghi”</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800d-9f8d-e344dfdb37ab" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Entropy coarse-grained (macrostate):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8085-915f-e6634b7b3d3d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{\text{cg}}(t) = -k\sum_i p_i(t)\ln p_i(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80af-a65f-d08f80f0c517" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Mệnh đề mũi tên (dưới điều kiện biên entropy thấp):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801f-b72b-dcc76a3865e8" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{d}{dt} S_{\text{cg}}(t) \ge 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8014-ba2f-d1ad60c68084" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Mutual information (định nghĩa bản ghi là tương quan bền):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8079-9784-cfc9de6fd538" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I(S:E_i)=H(S)+H(E_i)-H(S,E_i)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8004-be17-fbabd2e67e08" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Độ dư thừa bản ghi (redundancy) theo ngưỡng :</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8013-a866-fcb939293654" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
R_\theta(S:E) \equiv \max \left\{ N: I(S:E_i)\ge \theta \ \text{cho nhiều mảnh }E_i \right\}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8091-a860-ccfa62f456a8" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>“Hướng thời gian vận hành” = hướng mà redundancy tăng:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802f-8acd-c6b3f093cfa7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{d}{dt}R_\theta(S:E) &gt; 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8036-abda-ea515d974e2d"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8025-ad37-ffdb5662c28c" class="">G) Past Hypothesis: ràng buộc đo lường trên lịch sử</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ad-82ea-ce18f2dffae7" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Ràng buộc vi trạng thái ban đầu thuộc vùng macro entropy thấp:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8035-8e88-e3c6d69a379d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
x(t_0)\in \Gamma_{PH}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c2-ad80-ce06f30036d6" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Đo có điều kiện (typicality có điều kiện):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f6-8991-fa01e8a53299" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mu(\cdot \mid \Gamma_{PH}) = \frac{\mu(\cdot \cap \Gamma_{PH})}{\mu(\Gamma_{PH})}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8079-9f48-c07ad83fb1ea"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8005-8c2e-da52b8762bba" class="">H) Recursion depth: động lực lỗi + sửa lỗi</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8007-b2a1-e9c0176c444b" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Sai số mô hình theo tầng :</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8037-8bd8-c9a1f5044bc3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\varepsilon^{(d)}_t = \|m^{(d)}_t - \mathcal{T}^{(d)}_t\|</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807a-8c1e-cd08cfdedf4c" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Điều kiện ổn định (giới hạn trên theo thời gian):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80cc-88c3-d66da39649c2" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\sup_t \varepsilon^{(d)}_t \le \epsilon_d \quad \forall d\le D</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8039-987e-ede168a9e004" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Động lực sai số tối thiểu (khuếch đại + nhiễu − sửa):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806c-9871-edcb0a79556a" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\varepsilon^{(d)}_{t+1} = \alpha_d\,\varepsilon^{(d)}_t + \eta_d(t) - r_d(t)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804d-8c6d-c87343e037e5" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Điều kiện sửa lỗi thắng nhiễu (kỳ vọng):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8094-96aa-fd0dc451eccd" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathbb{E}[r_d] \ge \mathbb{E}[\eta_d] + (\alpha_d-1)\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon^{(d)}]</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f4-b9fe-f6210b7bf3d0" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Chỉ số “cổng bất khả hồi/phase transition” (dạng tổng hợp):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80da-a6f9-da5f4283ca3f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Omega_t = a\cdot \Delta H_{int}(t) + b\cdot \varepsilon_t + c\cdot \kappa_t - d\cdot CapGrowth_t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800e-a4d0-c4ad96199c76" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Omega_t \ge \tau \Rightarrow \text{phase transition}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8070-96a9-c07445e10815"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b1-ab63-ca5eaf7bd1a8" class="">I) Chi phí thông tin và giới hạn dung lượng vũ trụ</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807e-be27-e6ca8d0840fc" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Landauer (năng lượng tối thiểu để xoá 1 bit):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f5-b03c-edb764bce954" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
E_{\min} = kT\ln 2</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d5-8d8e-d16217b2ea7e" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Công suất tối thiểu để duy trì sửa lỗi/xoá rác ở độ sâu :</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807e-acee-d98094128212" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
P_{\min}(D) \ge kT\ln 2 \cdot \dot B(D)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80dd-adc4-da16aed32810" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Bekenstein bound (entropy tối đa trong vùng bán kính , năng lượng ):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805b-8dd7-d9617e4e2dc5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S \le \frac{2\pi k E R}{\hbar c}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8052-bb60-f45316ee6a9a" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Đổi sang số bit tối đa:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8095-af33-d5d7bc64af03" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I_{\max} \le \frac{S}{k\ln 2}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f5-82e8-f6be1abfdd5d" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Bán kính chân trời de Sitter (nếu tiệm cận hằng):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8023-b0cd-cfa655e35c66" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
R_H = \frac{c}{H}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8071-8f3d-fe8e6578d1a4" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Entropy chân trời de Sitter:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e3-9e44-f48e89762d41" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S_{dS} = \frac{k A}{4\ell_p^2}
= \frac{k\,4\pi R_H^2}{4\ell_p^2}
= \frac{\pi k}{\ell_p^2}\left(\frac{c}{H}\right)^2</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e4-b252-d095ee9b80fc" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Giới hạn thông tin theo chân trời (từ ):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8095-826a-efa957c36b9f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I_{\max} \le \frac{S_{dS}}{k\ln 2} \propto \frac{1}{H^2}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806a-976d-dfc096e12dab" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Bộ bất đẳng thức tổng hợp cho khả năng tăng recursion depth:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8027-bafc-d50d804717c2" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
P_{\text{available}} \ge kT\ln 2\cdot \dot B(D)
\quad \text{và}\quad
I_{\max} \ge I_{\text{records}}(D)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8078-be2b-f9e390005623"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a6-bfa1-dcd64aa2f2ed" class="">J) Chuỗi suy luận tổng hợp (quan hệ nhân quả đã chốt)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-809a-9ca2-ded075dedc27" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Chuỗi lõi (entropy → gradient → bản ghi → recursion):</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808d-a2ef-fb243b3147fe" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
Entropy\ gradient \Rightarrow Records \Rightarrow SelfReference \Rightarrow RecursionDepth</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800a-9605-fae48d7272b4" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Chuỗi “low-Weyl” → “hướng bản ghi”:</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a8-95de-dc008a071132" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
C_{abcd}\approx 0\ (t_0)
\Rightarrow S_{\text{grav}}(t_0)\ \text{thấp}
\Rightarrow \text{gradient dài hạn}
\Rightarrow \frac{d}{dt}R_\theta(S:E) &gt; 0</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80cd-bcfc-cd6665bb49ae"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8056-a201-d41850f9c0ec" class="">Nếu bạn muốn “overlooked hơn nữa” theo đúng nghĩa kỹ thuật, bạn chọn 1 trong 2 hướng sau (chỉ cần trả lời bằng “A” hoặc “B”):</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8056-b7a9-d07e209d2ebf" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><strong>A)</strong> Chuẩn hoá toàn bộ thành một hệ phương trình trạng thái rời rạc (đóng hệ, có ngưỡng ổn định/đổ vỡ rõ ràng).</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b5-bbf7-c5ef652b1aed" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><strong>B)</strong> Viết một bộ tiên đề tối thiểu (axioms) rồi chứng minh các hệ quả: mũi tên thời gian = hướng bản ghi, và trần recursion depth = (Landauer + Bekenstein + horizon).</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807b-802e-ec4d60b6f510" class="">1) Leakage Auditor (hard gate, not advisory)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f8-87cf-cac44a731ea6" class="">1.1 Definitions</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a6-a1d5-c78f07b855bb" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Dataset rows indexed by event-time</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8004-8f8d-eb10c072616d" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Feature function must be <strong>causal</strong> (uses only data at or before )</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c3-b9d8-ca3c39c4b907" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Label for horizon :</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c3-a1ed-df076128654f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
y^{(h)}_{i,t} = r_{i,t\to t+h}=\ln\left(\frac{P_{i,t+h}}{P_{i,t}}\right)</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8013-accc-d5c58c9c249f" class="">Leakage exists if any pipeline component uses  when producing any object consumed at decision time .</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8007-8ff5-cacaadb8f895" class="">1.2 Auditor invariants (deterministic)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808f-9d8a-f137808a6c50" class=""><strong>Invariant A (timestamp monotonicity):</strong><br/>For any derived column , every row’s source timestamps must satisfy:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d0-b172-eca86199b407" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\max \tau(\text{sources}(c_{t})) \le t</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e9-bf7c-e1fa30b1d342" class=""><strong>Invariant B (label independence at build time):</strong><br/>No feature column may be statistically “too predictive” of contemporaneous or future labels under a null that preserves causality.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8090-bd67-e3aa4b9e9154" class="">1.3 Concrete tests (pass/fail with thresholds)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ba-bb2d-ecbdbbaf50d6" class="">Test 1 — Forbidden-column dependency scan (static)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806a-9b11-d5d2769c6f73" class="">Maintain a forbidden set:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8057-959e-c54ad56b7002" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Any column containing future prices/returns at</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808c-8cfc-db4b8aecc73e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Any “target”, “label”, “forward”, “lead” fields</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8074-b2e0-d84376ece576" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Any merges keyed by future timestamp</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fe-856f-e3f9b333534d" class="">Rule:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8039-ac76-ef5a68d75907" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">If feature graph depends on forbidden nodes → BLOCKER.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-801b-84c0-fd7ffd849547" class="">Test 2 — Shift-consistency test (temporal perturbation)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806f-9b3a-e52e24692f89" class="">For each feature , create time-shifted variants:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80d8-8fd8-e1d87494a81d" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
x^{(+k)}_{i,t} := x_{i,t+k},\quad x^{(-k)}_{i,t} := x_{i,t-k}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-802a-a42f-f62a1444944c" class="">If performance improves materially when using <strong>future-shifted</strong> features:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f2-bba5-e2eb97ef63f2" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Score}(x^{(+k)} \to y^{(h)}) - \text{Score}(x \to y^{(h)}) \ge \Delta_{leak}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f8-856d-c93dbbf4316c" class="">Score can be AUC for sign(y) or  for y (choose one and standardize).</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8069-a1fe-c31e70d0b853" class="">Test 3 — “Same-bar” contamination test</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80fc-8d9a-e96417fe9856" class="">If you trade at bar-close but features use close, you must enforce:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a7-aaa4-eb180386e9fb" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">decision time consumes bar only.<br/>Check by rebuilding features with a strict lag:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8038-a716-c5ef49c7d7f5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
x^{lag}_{t} = x_{t-1}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8092-8808-da49bbf070d3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Perf}(x) - \text{Perf}(x^{lag}) \ge \Delta_{samebar}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c8-a9ec-cc2e976d25c0" class="">Test 4 — Purged walk-forward / embargo</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8019-afe9-fb6e6aa4db39" class="">When training on window  and testing , <strong>purge</strong> overlapping label information for horizon  and apply embargo :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8004-a127-d3b1e3bb5aba" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">remove training samples with</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800c-a47c-d9b3afd2f01a" class="">If performance collapses beyond threshold, flag as MAJOR:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f2-ad3e-c8ce85acdc92" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\text{Perf}_{unpurged} - \text{Perf}_{purged} \ge \Delta_{purge}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8029-b3bc-da541245f9a9" class="">1.4 Leakage termination gate</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8059-bc08-ef7e0ea11a76" class="">Define:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805a-a4de-c36780b628f1" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
LeakScore = \max(\Delta_{shift}, \Delta_{samebar}, \Delta_{purge})</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8049-968f-f3fcafb3c0c5" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">If any BLOCKER → <strong>Structurally Invalid</strong></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c4-8547-e0c62de1fda0" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Else if any MAJOR unresolved → <strong>Structurally Bounded</strong></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a4-96fe-d1aad3995987" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Else → passes leakage gate</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-807d-ba90-e645f6ced048" class="">1.5 AMOS placement (file-level)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808a-badb-fcd22b282180" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>03_IMMUNE/validation/leakage/</code><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-800d-b539-e993dc5131f8" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle"><code>leakage_report.py</code></li></ul></div></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b8-be98-f7234a652fed" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>01_BRAIN/kernel/audit.py</code> must call leakage gate during <code>build</code>.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8092-9ea1-df8eab324bf0" class="">Outputs:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-806d-8719-e9e208fb07c6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>17_OS/audits/&lt;run_id&gt;/issues.jsonl</code> (BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804f-9ecc-c3cb2887a982"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8080-9c9f-e95870e72919" class="">2) Causal Feature Compiler (a DSL that makes leakage hard to express)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e4-8d27-f1312cdfebd6" class="">2.1 Core principle</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808d-8866-ea08eaab541a" class="">You do not “write features”; you declare them in a DSL that only permits operators with <strong>provable temporal locality</strong>.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805c-befa-d89fa99342da" class="">Every feature must carry a <strong>time-support annotation</strong>:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8078-9593-e5fc09b81f00" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8098-b2c5-fe1bdec29eb0" class="">The compiler rejects any feature whose inferred support includes future time.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805e-9a7d-e3a9424da6fd" class="">2.2 Minimal DSL (deterministic)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8014-b875-d7a48c0d2bb0" class="">Feature spec is a typed AST:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-805d-9219-ef59c37ce30e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>Series(symbol, field)</code> → base stream</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8082-85b9-f6ec1d20eb97" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>Lag(expr, k)</code> where</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80b0-b9fe-e002ff22e5f8" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>Roll(expr, window, op)</code> where op ∈ {mean, std, min, max, sum}</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80f7-9673-c7acb8f73c73" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>EWMA(expr, beta)</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80df-a70a-fcc50ea1b8a6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>Diff(expr, k)</code> (implemented as Lag difference)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808e-925c-cdcd12b51218" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>ZScore(expr, window)</code> (built from Roll mean/std)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8011-9fd0-c7834357b0c6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>Clamp(expr, lo, hi)</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8014-bc19-d56f2faa5af7" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>If(cond, a, b)</code> (all branches must be causal)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8048-bed4-c2c6062ae4db" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>JoinOnTime(exprA, exprB)</code> only if timestamps align at same and both are causal</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a7-9c39-d3b01f2b4b65" class="">Forbidden in DSL:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-808a-b6c9-e52f907fa23e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><code>Lead</code></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-803b-9a83-c77b8f1f96c9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">any operator referencing for</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul p^{fill}_t = \frac{\sum_{\ell} p_{t,\ell}\, q^{fill}_{t,\ell}}{\sum_{\ell} q^{fill}_{t,\ell}+\epsilon}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80c7-86b8-f0f1b23bf7a0" class="">3.4 Microstructure stability gates</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="30cc5e6f-95bd-804d-afea-c5c9ef2fd51f" class="">Reject or scale trades if:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80ac-b650-c094b9e79818" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Spread too wide:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-8081-bcc1-f2f227e93152" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
s_t \ge s_{\max} \Rightarrow \rho_t \downarrow \text{ or no-trade}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80e6-9741-e3dc4464355f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
ADV_t \le ADV_{\min} \Rightarrow \text{no-trade}</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="30cc5e6f-95bd-80a9-b4b4-f2e527c9632a" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
